sources.label: Morphe patches for 🇵🇱 Polish apps. ⚠️ ONLY patches - no proprietary code or rebu
sources.author: Morphed PL
patch_list: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance, In-App Messaging and Sessions, removes the advertising ID permissions and the Google datatransport upload backend. Push notifications (FCM), RevenueCat and the weather API keep workin…
Removes the Google Play license check that shows "Get this app from Google Play" and closes the app when it was not installed from the Play Store.
Removes the banner ads (WP ads / Google Ad Manager) and the interstitial ads, and stops the ad SDK from starting at launch.
Injects an active premium entitlement into the RevenueCat response so the app reports premium tier without a subscription. Weather model UM 120h and ad-free mode become available.
